title: The unchanged local RHom normalization interface
statement: For a site C with independent object and arrow universes, a commutative ring sheaf R in coefficient universe max uC vC u, base and slice abelian sheafification with locally bijective characterization, and chosen derived categories, define exact derived slice restriction, local scalar multiplication descended through its localization factorization, coherent successive restriction, the normalized shift-sequence boundary, the Hom augmentation, a cycle class transported through a representative isomorphism, and localization of a local chain map. These are the literal formulas of the local cohomological bound interface; no object or morphism is changed.
